mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get custom cabinets installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom cabinet installation varies depending on the project's complexity, size, and material selections. Generally, from initial design approval to final installation, the process can take anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks. This includes design time, material procurement, fabrication, and installation. We provide a more accurate timeline estimate after our initial consultation and design phase, ensuring clear expectations for your project in Berkeley or Oakland.
